name: 劉琦允
objective: This course introduces the principles and practices of facility engineering and management for high-tech industries, including semiconductor, FPD (Flat Panel Display), biotechnology, and precision manufacturing. It covers critical infrastructure such as cleanrooms, HVAC systems, UPW, chemical and gas supply, power distribution, energy efficiency, carbon neutrality, and operational resilience.
schedule:
Week 1 – Introduction
Week 2 – Overview of Integrated Circuit Manufacturing
Week 3 – Fundamentals of Semiconductors
Week 4 – Wafer Fabrication
Week 5 – Cleanrooms and HVAC Systems
Week 6 – Ultrapure Water Treatment
Week 7 – CCSS (Centralized Chemical Supply Systems)
Week 8 – Centralized Gas Supply Systems
Week 9 – Midterm Group Project
Week 10 – Wastewater Treatment and Recycling
Week 11 – Power Systems and FMCS (Facility Monitoring and Control)
Week 12 – Facility Infrastructure Architecture
Week 13 – ESH (Environment, Safety, and Health) Management
Week 14 – Hook-up Design and Spatial Coordination
Week 15 – Fab Design Evaluation and Construction Supervision Management
Week 16 – Risk Assessment and Management Planning
Week 17 – High-Tech Fab Construction and Operating Cost Analysis
Week 18 – Final Group Project
scorePolicy:
Midterm group project：35%
Final group project：45%
Participation & In-Class Activities：20%
